title: Annotation API v2 NER request
description: Request body of POST /api/v2/entities/ner/ and /api/v2/entities/ner-nel/. The body of /api/ner/ plus split_sentences.

split_sentences.description: true splits data into sentences (Punkt with the Impresso abbreviations) before NER, so a long text is recognised to its end. false runs NER on data whole, as one sentence, cut at 512 sub-tokens: nothing past the cut is recognised. NEL always takes data whole.
